title: The Ocean Crown
unlock_policy: Complete a level to unlock the next; progress is shared across all four ships.
star_policy: One star for winning, one for finishing within star_targets.time, one for remaining health ratio >= star_targets.health. Best earned stars per level persist.

biomes.name: Sunlit Shoals
biomes.subtitle: Warm water. Cold steel.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Chasers approach slowly; runners carry treasure and flee.
biomes.environment: Turquoise ocean, sandy islets, palms, coral reefs.
biomes.introduction: Steer, skim past an enemy, and fire a broadside.

biomes.name: Mangrove Maze
biomes.subtitle: The swamp has eyes.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Skirmishers circle while rammers emerge from narrow channels.
biomes.environment: Emerald shallows, dense mangrove islands, wooden wrecks.
biomes.introduction: Keep your broadside toward circling raiders and ride the currents.

biomes.name: Ember Archipelago
biomes.subtitle: Hot shots. Bigger explosions.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Snipers keep distance; explosive mines punish straight approaches.
biomes.environment: Volcanic islands, black sand, warm ember lights, drifting powder kegs.
biomes.introduction: Angle between cannon shots and give glowing powder kegs room.

biomes.name: Frostwake Reach
biomes.subtitle: Cool head. Quick hands.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Fast rammers pressure turns; snipers use iceberg cover.
biomes.environment: Arctic blue water, snow-capped islands, ice floes.
biomes.introduction: Use wide turns around the ice and punish fast ships as they pass.

biomes.name: Tempest Crown
biomes.subtitle: One sea. One pirate king.
biomes.enemy_behavior: Mixed formations use storms and whirlpools to surround the player.
biomes.environment: Midnight purple ocean, storm-lit islands, bright magical whirlpools.
biomes.introduction: Read the whole fleet, escape the whirlpool, and claim the crown.

levels.name: First Broadside
levels.briefing: Sink 4 deckhands. Turn the wheel, then tap either cannon.
levels.design_note: Guided opener. Single predictable enemies, no hazards, and a guaranteed repair.

levels.name: Coral Courtesy
levels.briefing: Sink 6 deckhands while giving the coral island room.
levels.design_note: One wide reef introduces steering around terrain. No advanced enemies.

levels.name: Two-Sided Trouble
levels.briefing: Sink 8 ships. Both sides reload separately: keep the cannons singing.
levels.design_note: Introduces a treasure runner among slow chasers; rewards switching broadsides.

levels.name: Gold Rush Bay
levels.briefing: Collect 12 treasure coins from the bay and fleeing ships.
levels.design_note: First treasure objective. Stationary pickups allow a movement-focused route.

levels.name: Round the Palms
levels.briefing: Stay afloat for 50 seconds through a playful pirate parade.
levels.design_note: Introduces the orbiting skirmisher; survival teaches retreat and repair pickup.

levels.name: Broadside Boulevard
levels.briefing: Sink 12 ships along the open water between the shoals.
levels.design_note: Open broadside lanes with two coral obstacles; alternating side pressure.

levels.name: Treasure Tailwind
levels.briefing: Gather 18 coins. A gentle tailwind carries you toward treasure.
levels.design_note: First current has zero direct damage and encourages wide pickup sweeps.

levels.name: Sloop Soup
levels.briefing: Sink 15 ships without getting boxed in by the shoals.
levels.design_note: Small fleet pressure tests turning while firing.

levels.name: Sunset Skirmish
levels.briefing: Survive the sunset fleet for 70 seconds.
levels.design_note: Final warm-up mixes loot, orbiting fire, and light obstacle density.

levels.name: Captain Coconut
levels.briefing: Sink Captain Coconut and win passage to the mangroves.
levels.design_note: Slow, readable first boss with long gaps between broadside volleys.

levels.name: Greenwater Greeting
levels.briefing: Sink 12 ships in the winding greenwater channels.
levels.design_note: Biome opener uses one current and moderate skirmisher pressure.

levels.name: Current Affairs
levels.briefing: Collect 20 coins while the tides tug at your sails.
levels.design_note: Two currents form a movement challenge without heavy combat.

levels.name: Mangrove Mouths
levels.briefing: Sink 14 ships. Dodge the first Reef Ram as it charges.
levels.design_note: First rammer arrives after 30 seconds; ample open space outside the mangroves.

levels.name: Driftwood Derby
levels.briefing: Survive 75 seconds in a drifting derby of charging ships.
levels.design_note: Rammer-focused survival with currents complicating straight escapes.

levels.name: Smuggler's Shortcut
levels.briefing: Collect 24 coins before the smugglers vanish into the swamp.
levels.design_note: No solid terrain; a fast treasure chase threaded by currents.

levels.name: Root and Cannon
levels.briefing: Sink 18 ships around the mangrove roots.
levels.design_note: Dense islands favor deliberate turns and close broadside windows.

levels.name: Swamp Carousel
levels.briefing: Stay afloat for 85 seconds as raiders circle your ship.
levels.design_note: Orbiting pressure rewards switching cannons and moving against the current.

levels.name: Ram Jam
levels.briefing: Sink 16 ships, including a rowdy gang of Reef Rams.
levels.design_note: Few hazards and fewer enemy slots offset the aggressive rammer composition.

levels.name: Last Light Lagoon
levels.briefing: Gather 28 coins from the lagoon before the admiral arrives.
levels.design_note: Mixed combat treasure race provides final mangrove skill check.

levels.name: Admiral Alligator
levels.briefing: Outturn Admiral Alligator and sink the swamp's flagship.
levels.design_note: Fast charge boss with a long reload and two tidal channels.

levels.name: Welcome to the Boom
levels.briefing: Sink 16 ships and keep clear of glowing powder kegs.
levels.design_note: Introduces snipers and two widely separated mines.

levels.name: Powder Keg Picnic
levels.briefing: Collect 26 coins between the floating powder kegs.
levels.design_note: Treasure route requires gaps between fixed explosive hazards.

levels.name: Longshot Lookout
levels.briefing: Sink 18 ships. Close the distance on the Longshots.
levels.design_note: Kiting snipers force aggressive approach angles.

levels.name: Black Sand Sprint
levels.briefing: Survive 85 seconds along the black sand coast.
levels.design_note: Alternating long-range and charge pressure; one cross-current changes approach angles.

levels.name: Cinder Smugglers
levels.briefing: Collect 30 coins from the smugglers' glowing cargo.
levels.design_note: Treasure runners are numerous, but mine density makes pursuit risky.

levels.name: Ash and Splash
levels.briefing: Sink 22 ships through smoke, splashes, and flying cannonballs.
levels.design_note: Balanced fleet brawl with three explosive and three solid obstacles.

levels.name: Ember Evasion
levels.briefing: Stay afloat for 95 seconds as the ember storm rolls in.
levels.design_note: First periodic danger zone is readable among a sniper-heavy fleet.

levels.name: Barrel Roll Bay
levels.briefing: Sink 20 ships while weaving around the barrel field.
levels.design_note: Open sea packed with mines: tight turns and firing angles matter.

levels.name: The Last Hot Haul
levels.briefing: Collect 36 coins before the volcanic flagship sails.
levels.design_note: High-value treasure objective combines mines and drifting approaches.

levels.name: Commodore Cinder
levels.briefing: Sink Commodore Cinder before the sea becomes a firework.
levels.design_note: Three-shot fan volleys and powder kegs make positioning the core challenge.

levels.name: Cold Open
levels.briefing: Sink 20 ships in the bright, icy reach.
levels.design_note: Biome reset trades explosive hazards for large icebergs.

levels.name: Iceberg Express
levels.briefing: Collect 32 coins between the drifting icebergs.
levels.design_note: Obstacle-heavy route with charging pursuers and a slow cross-current.

levels.name: Snowball Fight
levels.briefing: Sink 24 ships as cannonballs pepper the frosty sea.
levels.design_note: Mixed-range crossfire behind a few large icebergs.

levels.name: Polar Pursuit
levels.briefing: Survive 95 seconds against relentless polar pursuers.
levels.design_note: Rammer-weighted chase asks players to predict large turning arcs.

levels.name: Frozen Fortune
levels.briefing: Collect 38 coins from the frozen treasure fleet.
levels.design_note: Dense iceberg slalom with runners and occasional long shots.

levels.name: Hull on Ice
levels.briefing: Sink 26 ships while the polar currents tug your hull.
levels.design_note: Combines close orbiters and fast rams in opposing currents.

levels.name: Whiteout Watch
levels.briefing: Survive 105 seconds in the sparkling whiteout.
levels.design_note: Two timed storm zones force movement during long-range pressure.

levels.name: Berg Brawl
levels.briefing: Sink 28 ships in a crowded iceberg brawl.
levels.design_note: Strong mixed enemies around bulky cover, with a generous time limit.

levels.name: Northern Lights Heist
levels.briefing: Collect 42 coins beneath the northern lights.
levels.design_note: Frost biome culmination focuses on reading a dense treasure route.

levels.name: Baron Blizzard
levels.briefing: Break Baron Blizzard's hull and sail toward the storm crown.
levels.design_note: Fast charging boss makes icebergs useful cover as well as obstacles.

levels.name: Eye of the Tide
levels.briefing: Sink 26 ships. Steer wide of the magical whirlpool.
levels.design_note: One whirlpool introduces suction without dense secondary hazards.

levels.name: Stormbound Spoils
levels.briefing: Collect 40 coins through storm-lit water.
levels.design_note: Two telegraphed storm zones surround a central whirlpool treasure route.

levels.name: Crown's Crossfire
levels.briefing: Sink 30 ships in the crown fleet's crossfire.
levels.design_note: Sniper weighting and a charging flank reward decisive movement.

levels.name: Whirlpool Waltz
levels.briefing: Survive 110 seconds in the whirlpools' tug-of-war.
levels.design_note: Two suction zones and close-range enemies create a navigation endurance test.

levels.name: Royal Ransom
levels.briefing: Collect 46 coins from the royal ransom fleet.
levels.design_note: High treasure density permits multiple routes around the whirlpool and mines.

levels.name: Thunderstruck Fleet
levels.briefing: Sink 32 ships while thunder shakes the fleet.
levels.design_note: Three periodic danger zones challenge repositioning during a full fleet brawl.

levels.name: The Sea Bites Back
levels.briefing: Stay afloat for 2 minutes against the storm crown's finest.
levels.design_note: Survival capstone introduces the full enemy roster in paced waves.

levels.name: Last Broadside Standing
levels.briefing: Sink 36 ships and clear the monarch's last escort.
levels.design_note: Largest regular combat target, tempered by a 165-second deadline.

levels.name: Crown Jewel Caper
levels.briefing: Collect 50 coins to draw the pirate monarch from the storm.
levels.design_note: Largest treasure target and two route-blocking whirlpools set up the finale.

levels.name: The Pirate Monarch
levels.briefing: Sink the Pirate Monarch. The ocean crown is yours.
levels.design_note: Final four-cannon boss, a whirlpool, and timed storm zones; slow reinforcement cadence leaves firing windows.

endless.name: Endless Ocean
endless.seed_policy: Random seed each voyage. Decorate ocean chunks deterministically from the voyage seed.
